searchText: Hello! Question, After PBS is implemented, will the validators still be able to create blocks in case no builders bid for a block? Or it will be an assumption that there will always be builders.

excerpts.author: terere.eth
excerpts.content:
Hello!  Question,

After PBS is implemented, will the validators still be able to create blocks in case no builders bid for a block?  Or it will be an assumption that there will always be builders.
